scope: Systematic internet discovery and security-gated intake of homeschool teaching and administration agent skills
search_queries: education curriculum lesson planning "agent skills" github
homeschool agent skill attendance records transcript compliance github skills
homeschool "agent skills" legal compliance state records github -site:skillsmp.com -site:toolify.ai

sources.credibility_basis: Named educator and curriculum designer; public CV and source research references. Evidence interpretations are not independently validated.
sources.decision: 22 document-only packages admitted; remaining skills not needed for this intake. ai-claim-checker has unresolved raw scanner flags and is excluded.

sources.credibility_basis: Institutional education publisher; co-development and attribution independently confirmed by Anthropic companion repository.
sources.decision: Two document-only skills admitted. Full lesson creation/differentiation packages deferred because they include rendering scripts and provider workflow requirements.

sources.credibility_basis: First-party institutional repository, co-developed with Learning Commons.
sources.decision: Companion of the Learning Commons source; no duplicate copies admitted.

sources.credibility_basis: Identified author Brad Busenius; transparent local-first homeschool workflow and companion dashboard. Community project, not an institutional endorsement.
sources.decision: Five document-only record-workflow adaptations admitted. Family runtime, messaging, private registries, remote sync, alarms, paid/API-key integrations and rendering scripts excluded.

sources.credibility_basis: Primary vendor-maintained source with explicit MIT license and concrete task/quality contracts. No independent classroom efficacy claim.
sources.decision: Quiz Generator and Student Feedback Writer admitted; overlapping lesson/curriculum/rubric skills deferred.

sources.credibility_basis: Primary organization-maintained source with MIT license, safety references and example eval prompts. No independent efficacy claim.
sources.decision: Arts and Crafts admitted. Circle-time timing/public-domain tune assertions need further review; other packages overlap or include renderers.

sources.credibility_basis: Identified primary maintainer; README/package claim MIT.
sources.decision: No bundled LICENSE file found; full redistribution notice not established. No content admitted.

sources.credibility_basis: Named primary author with explicit MIT license.
sources.decision: Missouri-specific school-law and broad routing assumptions; multiple unresolved automated security flags. Not admitted. Flags are not confirmed exploits.
External MindMeister/MeisterTask accounts and connector workflows are outside the portable document-only intake. No account connected.

General supporting skills reviewed; existing Broville PDF, notebook, transcription or other skills already cover useful support. No domain-specific addition selected; source flags in unrelated tooling are not admitted.

sources.credibility_basis: Named primary maintainer, explicit MIT license; used only to satisfy the user coding preference.
sources.decision: Only the plain skills/ponytail/SKILL.md instructions were used in Full Mode. That exact entrypoint had no scanner findings. No installation, hooks or code was executed, and no Ponytail content was added to Broville. Other source flags remain unadjudicated.

discovery_only.decision: Directory listing; no verified primary licensed source recovered in this search. Not downloaded or admitted.
Primary metadata checked: Taiwan K–12 and Chinese-language curriculum, NOASSERTION license metadata. Not downloaded; requires locale and license review.
Primary metadata checked; broad MIT agent catalog including FamilyTutor. Not downloaded; overlaps selected pedagogy, and domain-authorship verification would be needed before admission.
Primary metadata checked; interactive learning/showcase infrastructure with NOASSERTION license metadata. Not downloaded or admitted; package and license review still needed.
Research-generated persona example is not an established homeschool administration workflow. No package downloaded or admitted.
Open education marketing/deep-dive content and video workflows, rather than household learning administration; not downloaded or admitted.
Broad organizational compliance tooling; not a jurisdiction-specific homeschool law source. Not downloaded or admitted.
Official document skills discovered and individual license metadata inspected; no full package downloaded or admitted. Broville already has PDF support; office-code intake is separate.
Official Google Drive/Docs/Sheets/Slides workflows discovered. Connector-specific; already available in this chat and not copied into a portable repository package.
Family-assistant template handles sensitive household information; not downloaded or admitted as a homeschool records package.

security.policy_delta: Cisco strict settings preserved; .codex-plugin added to conventional dot-directories after verifying the only contained file is the byte-for-byte regenerated plugin.json with no apps, hooks or MCP servers. Content analysis still runs. The unmodified strict pass flagged this metadata in every selected package; those raw flags were reviewed, not concealed.
manual_review_scope: Primary source identity, declared licenses, revision pinning and attribution
Instruction boundaries, privacy, source-data prompt injection, automatic installation/execution and outbound sharing
Portability and the absence of family-specific runtime dependencies in admitted record adaptations
Document-only inventory, no symlinks/executable artifacts, token/private-key and Unicode concealment pattern checks
Output/source distinction, missing-evidence handling, backups, deduplication and protection of prior records
limits: Automated scans are best-effort, not security certification. Upstream severity flags are candidates, not confirmed vulnerabilities.

No candidate script, installer, hook, external service or student-data integration was run. Admitted packages contain no executable code or dependency manifests; OSV therefore does not establish a runtime-dependency safety claim.
No scanner LLM/cloud judge, VirusTotal, or AI Defense cloud service was used. This agent performed the semantic intake review.
The Codex Security workflow shared reference/preflight resources could not be read in this environment; this is a Cisco scan plus local review, not a completed Codex Security scan.
No live classroom, legal-compliance, long-term learner-outcome or third-party connector evaluation was performed.
The final scan covers 41 productivity packages; the admission decision and content hashes apply only to the 32 additions.
Search-engine indexing, inaccessible content, private repositories and newly published skills prevent a literal claim to have exhausted the entire internet.
